verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents shell integration that tracks history, working directory and hostname "even over ssh". It can switch to a dedicated profile when you ssh to a given host, and its tmux -CC integration and SCP-based download/upload features work across SSH sessions. However, nothing in the evidence shows a built-in SSH wrapper that automatically copies terminfo, shell integration or user config to the remote host; the profile switching shown is local behavior. Missing for 10: built-in SSH command or kitten-style integration, automatic terminfo propagation to remote hosts, automatic carrying of shell integration and config to the remote without manual install, and independent hands-on corroboration.
